official.deadline_note: For the January semester (January 2027 intake) applications open from 25/08/2026 to 20/10/2026; results are emailed in late November 2026 and must be answered within 14 days. The September semester window (15/04/2026 to 15/07/2026, results late August 2026) has closed. No separate institutional deadline is published.
official.status_note: TDTU's 14/04/2026 announcement confirms undergraduate applications for the 2026-2027 academic year are being accepted by email, with the January 2027 semester window running 25/08/2026-20/10/2026, so the round is open and closes in 10 days as of 10 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Full scholarship: '100% Tuition fee for undergraduate program (not include tuition fee for the courses that students study for the second time)' plus '100% Dormitory fee'. Partial scholarship: '50-75% Tuition fee for undergraduate program (not include tuition fee for the courses that students study for the second time)' plus '100% Dormitory fee'. For Vietnamese-taught programmes the Vietnamese language class tuition is also 100% covered under both types, excluding second-time study of that class.
benefits: Full scholarship: 100% tuition fee for the undergraduate program, excluding tuition for courses studied a second time
Partial scholarship: 50-75% tuition fee for the undergraduate program, excluding tuition for courses studied a second time
For Vietnamese-taught undergraduate programs: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee (excluding second-time study of that class), under both full and partial scholarships

For students enrolling in Vietnamese-taught undergraduate programs at the Khanh Hoa Branch: 05 full living allowance scholarships of VND 4,000,000 per month and 20 partial living allowance scholarships of VND 2,500,000 per month
eligibility: High school diploma or equivalent, with graduation time in 2027, 2026 or 2025
Average GPA of High School Study or Average GPA of High School Graduation Exam of at least 5.0/10 (note: TDTU's own pages publish differing scholarship GPA thresholds of 5.0, 6.5 and 8.0/10)
For undergraduate programs taught in English: citizen of an English-native-speaking country, or a valid IELTS of at least 5.5 (or an accepted equivalent certificate)

For undergraduate programs taught in Vietnamese: a Vietnamese language proficiency test result or certificate of at least B2 level, or attendance of 01 year of Vietnamese language study at TDTU followed by passing the final proficiency test at B2 level or above

Applicants from Myanmar: the High School Transcript is strictly required, not the Matriculation Examination result; the matriculation result is only accepted with a Confirmation Form signed and stamped by the local authority or local Department of Education confirming the applicant did not attend high school education
Must be officially admitted by Ton Duc Thang University and satisfy all scholarship maintenance requirements throughout their studies
requirements: Hold a high school diploma or equivalent graduating in 2027, 2026 or 2025, with an average high school study GPA or graduation exam GPA of at least 5.0/10 as published on the scholarship page

Meet the language proficiency requirement of the chosen programme: IELTS 5.5 or equivalent (or English-native citizenship) for English-taught programmes; Vietnamese B2 or one year of Vietnamese study at TDTU plus a passed B2 test for Vietnamese-taught programmes
For the Pharmacy major: final-year senior high school GPA marked 'Good' or above and an average Chemistry score of at least 7.0/10.0
For Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design: take TDTU's aptitude assessment test before entering the Bachelor's programme

Send scanned copies of the required documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period; an application is only considered valid when sufficient and correct documents are submitted

Meet the retention criteria each academic year to keep the scholarship: previous-year GPA not below 6.0 for English-taught undergraduate study; for Vietnamese-taught study, pass the Vietnamese proficiency language class at B2 level and keep a previous-year GPA not below 5.0
documents: TDTU Application form, filled with applicant information, programme type and intended major (scanned for application, hard copy on arrival in Vietnam)

High school diploma or equivalent, translated into Vietnamese or English, notarised and authenticated by the local state department, and consular-authenticated by the Vietnamese diplomatic body in the applicant's country
Transcript/academic record of high school, translated, notarised and consular-authenticated in the same way
Passport or ID card, translated if an ID card is used (passport needs no translation), valid for at least 06 more months

Health check/health certificate in Vietnamese or English (general check, no specific medical test), plus a health certificate issued by authorised bodies in Vietnam following Circular 14/2013/TT-BYT once in Vietnam

Language evidence: valid IELTS 5.5 or accepted equivalent for English-taught programmes, or a Vietnamese proficiency certificate at B2 or above for Vietnamese-taught programmes; plus the TDTU aptitude assessment test result for the design and architecture majors, and the signed and stamped Confirmation Form where a matriculation result is used instead of a high school transcript
selection_criteria: The International Admission Council will select the applicants with the highest academic performances to offer the scholarships
The level of award (partial or full) depends on the applicant's academic performance and language proficiency performance
The scholarship is reviewed annually based on the student's academic performance in accordance with the University's regulations
Renewal each academic year requires meeting the retention criteria (previous-year GPA not below 6.0 for English-taught study; B2 Vietnamese class plus GPA not below 5.0 for Vietnamese-taught study)
coverage: Full scholarship: 100% of undergraduate tuition fee and 100% of dormitory fee
Partial scholarship: 50-75% of undergraduate tuition fee and 100% of dormitory fee
For Vietnamese-taught programmes: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee, excluding second-time study of that class

Living-cost support is limited to the 100% dormitory fee under both award types, plus monthly living allowances (VND 4,000,000 full / VND 2,500,000 partial) only for students enrolling in Vietnamese-taught programmes at the Khanh Hoa Branch
Not covered: tuition for any course studied a second time, flights/visa costs and general living expenses outside the dormitory
application_method: Follow the TDTU admissions procedure and timeline for the target semester
Prepare the required documents as listed on TDTU's application form and documents page, with the required translations, notarisation and consular authentication
Send scanned copies of all documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period
The International Admission Council reviews complete applications and selects the applicants with the highest academic performances
Eligible applicants are notified of the result by email (late November 2026 for the January 2027 semester)
Respond to the result notification within 14 days, because the scholarship result is terminated and transferred to other applicants if there is no response
official.application_route: Email scanned copies of the required documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application window (25/08/2026-20/10/2026 for the January 2027 semester); no separate scholarship form or portal is published
official.citizenship_residency: Published for international students only; no nationality restriction, but applicants from Myanmar must use the high school transcript rather than the matriculation result, and country-specific instruction sheets exist for Cambodian, Laotian, Chinese and other applicants
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is published specifically for international students; TDTU states international students pay the same tuition and dormitory fees as local students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: English-taught route: 11 majors. Vietnamese-taught route: 51 majors, with scholarships not applied for the major of Vietnamese Studies - Vietnamese language, Culture & Society. Pharmacy, Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design carry additional requirements
official.duration: 04-05 years for the undergraduate programme depending on major (typically four years; Pharmacy five years), preceded by 01 compulsory year of Vietnamese language study for Vietnamese-taught programme applicants without a B2 Vietnamese proficiency certificate
official.description: Ton Duc Thang University describes itself as a young, aspiring and dynamically growing institution in Ho Chi Minh City and states that it annually offers various types of scholarships to encourage international students to study at the University. Its 2026-2027 scholarship programme for international undergraduate applicants ranges from partial to full depending on the applicant's academic performance and language proficiency performance, covering tuition and dormitory fees.
official.region: Asia (Vietnam - main campus in Ho Chi Minh City; Khanh Hoa Branch for the Vietnamese-taught living allowances)
official.program_type: University-funded admission scholarship (partial to full tuition fee and dormitory fee coverage) for international undergraduate students
official.english_requirement: For undergraduate programmes taught in English: a valid IELTS score of at least 5.5 or an accepted equivalent certificate; applicants who are citizens of an English-native-speaking country satisfy the requirement without a test. For programmes taught in Vietnamese: a Vietnamese proficiency test result or certificate of at least B2 level, or one year of Vietnamese language study at TDTU followed by passing TDTU's Vietnamese proficiency test at B2 level or above

verification.notes: Verified against TDTU's own admission site: the 2026-2027 scholarship announcement, the 14/04/2026 application announcement, the 2026 fee page and the application form and documents page. The award is published as percentages of tuition and dormitory fees rather than a single monetary sum, so funding_amount/currency/period stay null; the only VND figures TDTU publishes are the Khanh Hoa living allowances (VND 4,000,000 and VND 2,500,000 per month). TDTU's own pages publish conflicting high-school GPA thresholds for the scholarship (5.0/10 in the scholarship eligibility section, 6.5/10 in the April 2026 announcement and FAQ, 8.0/10 in an inclusions note on the scholarship page), so the lower 5.0/10 figure is recorded as published and the conflict is flagged in alerts.

applicant_utility.summary: TDTU's international undergraduate award is a percentage-based fee waiver rather than a cash grant: a full award covers 100% of tuition and 100% of the dormitory fee, while a partial award covers 50-75% of tuition plus the full dormitory fee, with the level set by academic and language performance. The January 2027 round closes on 20 October 2026, and an application only becomes valid once a complete, correctly legalised set of scans reaches admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn, so document preparation is the real race. Because the award level is performance-based, the strength of your final-year transcript and your IELTS 5.5+ or Vietnamese B2 evidence matters far more than any essay, and the award must be re-earned every year with a 6.0+ GPA (5.0+ plus a passed B2 Vietnamese class for Vietnamese-taught students).
applicant_utility.best_fit: International high school graduates from 2025-2027 with strong transcripts who want an affordable English- or Vietnamese-taught bachelor's in Ho Chi Minh City and can evidence IELTS 5.5 or Vietnamese B2
application_readiness_checklist: Check your graduation year against the 2025/2026/2027 rule and compute both your high school study average and graduation-exam average, since TDTU lists either as the qualifying measure
Book IELTS early if applying to an English-taught programme: a valid 5.5+ (or accepted equivalent) is the scholarship requirement, with citizenship of an English-native country the only exemption

For Pharmacy, confirm your final-year GPA is 'Good' or above with Chemistry at least 7.0/10; for Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design or Industrial Design, register for TDTU's aptitude assessment test before the programme starts
Myanmar applicants: secure the high school transcript, and obtain the signed and stamped Confirmation Form only if you must rely on a matriculation result

Start document legalisation now: diploma and transcript need translation, notarisation and consular authentication by the Vietnamese embassy or consulate in your country, and your passport must stay valid at least six more months

Email the complete scan set to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn well before 20/10/2026, ask for confirmation of receipt, then diarise the late-November result email and its 14-day response deadline
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete or non-conforming scans, since TDTU states an application is only considered valid when sufficient and correct documents are submitted
Missing notarised translation or consular authentication of the high school diploma or transcript
Myanmar applicants submitting a matriculation examination result instead of the required high school transcript
Applying to the design or architecture majors without having taken TDTU's aptitude assessment test
Failing to answer the award email within 14 days, after which TDTU terminates the result and transfers it to other applicants
A weak final-year academic average, because the International Admission Council selects the applicants with the highest academic performances
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Under a partial award the student still pays 25-50% of tuition: on TDTU's published 2026 figures that is 20,000,000-40,000,000 VND per academic year for English-taught programmes (VND 80,000,000/year) or 12,500,000-17,500,000 VND per year for Vietnamese-taught standard programmes (VND 25,000,000-35,000,000/year). Even a full award leaves out tuition for any course studied a second time, plus flights and visa costs, the Vietnam-issued health certificate, and day-to-day living expenses beyond the dormitory.
document_audit: The diploma and the transcript each need their own translation, notarisation and consular legalisation, a chain that typically takes weeks, so begin before the 20 October deadline
Your passport must remain valid for at least six more months, a common last-minute blocker

The international student profile must be signed by you and confirmed by your local state department, and the commitment form signed by you; both are submitted as hard copies on arrival in Vietnam rather than with the online application
The Vietnam-issued health certificate under Circular 14/2013/TT-BYT cannot be obtained abroad; TDTU arranges it after you arrive
Country-specific instruction sheets exist for Cambodian, Laotian and Chinese applicants and a separate sheet for all other applicants, so use the one that matches your country
alerts: Timing trap: as of 10 October 2026 the only open route is the January 2027 semester window (25/08-20/10/2026); the September 2026 window closed on 15/07/2026

TDTU's own pages publish three different high-school GPA thresholds for this scholarship (5.0, 6.5 and 8.0/10); treat the higher figures as the effective bar and confirm your standing with admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn
The result email is final only once you reply; no response within 14 days and the award is terminated and given to another applicant
The monthly living allowances (VND 4,000,000 full, VND 2,500,000 partial) exist solely for Vietnamese-taught programmes at the Khanh Hoa Branch and are capped at 5 full and 20 partial awards
The scholarship must be re-earned annually: a previous-year GPA below 6.0 (English-taught) or below 5.0 plus an unpassed B2 Vietnamese class (Vietnamese-taught) ends the renewal
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Legalise and scan the document set, email it to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn inside the window, receive the admission and scholarship decision by email in late November, confirm within 14 days, then travel to Vietnam and hand in hard-copy originals plus the Vietnam-issued health certificate on arrival
